# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/reactions

Get a list of reactions of an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-303`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer (int64) | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []api.Reaction

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `user` | api.User | The user who created the reaction |
| `content` | string | The reaction type/emoji |
| `created_at` | time.Time | When the reaction was created |
